notes: Curated, source-backed claims. CONFIRMED_FACT entries are checked against primary sources (Rockstar Games). THEORY/SPECULATION entries must keep their hedge in narration. Re-verify anything with recheckAfter in the past before use. Retrieved dates are when the source was read.

facts.label: CONFIRMED_FACT
facts.claim: GTA VI's story is a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida.
facts.line: The story is a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the entire state of Leonida.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI - Rockstar Games
sources.quote: a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida

facts.label: THEORY
facts.claim: Leonida is widely interpreted as Rockstar's satirical version of Florida (Vice City having long been read as a Miami parody). Rockstar has not said this.
facts.line: Most fans read Leonida as Rockstar's take on Florida, though Rockstar has never said that outright.

facts.label: THEORY
facts.claim: Fans widely believe Grassrivers is modeled on the Florida Everglades. Rockstar has not confirmed this.
facts.line: Grassrivers is widely believed to be Rockstar's version of the Everglades. That part isn't confirmed.

facts.label: SPECULATION
facts.claim: Speculation: Cal's Coast Guard monitoring could matter for boat-based jobs. Nothing official supports this.
facts.line: Here's the speculation: a guy who monitors Coast Guard radio could be very useful for boat jobs. Nothing official yet.

facts.claim: GTA VI has two named protagonists on the official site: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
facts.line: This time the story is split between two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

sources.quote: Jason Duval ... Lucia Caminos
